feeds.title: Arthur Morris/BIRDS AS ART
feeds.description: Arthur Morris is a free-lance nature photographer, writer, educator, and trip leader specializing in birds. He is widely recognized as the world's premier bird photographer and as one of the top nature photography educators of his time. On his website and blog, his record of sharing his photographic and avian knowledge is unmatched.

feeds.title: Steven Bird Photography Blog
feeds.description: In this blog you will find field tips for premier bird image creation and tricks to greately improve your digital photo processing. For each bird picture you will see, I break down the setting on the equipment I used and walk you through a few image editing techniques to bring the final artistic touches.

feeds.title: Yoav Perlman
feeds.description: Yoav Perlman is a Birder, ecologist, conservationist, wildlife photographer, and blogger. His website yoavperlman.com includes blogs related to bird photography, science, conservation, and birding. His blogs involve knowledge regarding Birds, wildlife, bird photography, and many more. He has written blogs on Amur Falcon, Crackling Goose, Bull Finch, and a lot more.

feeds.title: Jason Polak
feeds.description: I'm Jason Polak, I am a bird and wildlife photographer. My blog covers articles on numerous birds also my long-term goals are to promote the conservation of birds and wildlife through photography and scientific study and see and photograph 5000 birds. Various informative articles on different varieties of cameras used for bird photography, a proper guide, and information are also provided in my blogs.

feeds.title: Brian's Birding Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Brian Anderson. Read information and perspectives about birding in Essex. This blog is a diary of my trips around the country chasing birds. Enjoyed every place I visit, caught the cherishing moments of birds in my photographs, and also met different people along the way, and through every article, that entire experience is expressed.

feeds.title: Zoothera Birding Blog
feeds.description: I'm Nick Bray, the owner of Zoothera Birding, a UK-based birding holiday company. Our emphasis is on seeing all birds and wildlife well and, like most birders, we like the endemics, rare, scarce, specialty, and skulking species a lot! On our website, you may get to see different articles on birding and bird photography of common as well as unheard species of birds.

feeds.title: Birding Poole Harbour & Beyond
feeds.description: The website Birding Poole Harbour and Beyond shares the wonderful experience of birding through the means of photographs and articles. Through these blogs, you can go through my experience of traveling to different places and capturing incredible moments with birds and wildlife.

feeds.title: Wanstead Birder
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jonathan Lethbridge, this blog is majorly about birding in Wanstead, Essex, London, the rest of the country, and abroad. I share different birding experiences through my blog. There are various articles on birding and bird photography along with that on this website, I also sometimes post articles on injustices, muggers, scroungers, housework, and many more.

feeds.title: Bear River ger Blog
feeds.description: This blog offers an informal piece of information about the Bear River Migratory Bird Refuge, based on personal experiences with the refuge. Bear River Migratory is just one of the hundreds of fascinating bird species that visit the refuge throughout the year. Over 270 species of avian friends have been documented on and around the refuge. Many of these birds are migratory. A complete detailed article on bear river migratory birds and article is listed in our blog.

feeds.title: Birding Through Glass
feeds.description: Birding Through Glass is a site related to birds by Jerry Jourdan and Robin Jourdan. Both started this website in 2007 their website majorly includes Capturing Moments of Michigan Birds, Birding, Digiscoping, and Bird Photography.

feeds.title: Austin's Birding Blog
feeds.description: All the wonderful birds and wildlife of Lancashire, Cheshire, North Wales, and further are mentioned in this blog. I'm an ecologist and professional photographer, I capture all beautiful insights of birds and wildlife and share them on my website Austin's Birding Blog.

feeds.title: The Deskbound Birder
feeds.description: I am Simon Colenutt, my blog aims to present a briefer summary of my birding as well as post some of my photos from previous trips from my ever-expanding library. I have all my sightings, and photos photographed and is been posted here in this particular blog.

feeds.title: Adrian Davey Wildlife Photography Diary
feeds.description: Hi, welcome to Adrian Davey Wildlife Photography blog. I have been photographing wildlife for many years now and have had a love for nature and especially birds since childhood. All these years of birding insights and involvement in wildlife are all photographed and shared on this particular blog page.

feeds.title: Steve Carey Bird Photography
feeds.description: I'm Steve Carey, I've Been Birdwatching Since 2005, My local patch for Birdwatching is Lodmoor Nature Reserve RSPB and Radipole Lake Nature Reserve RSPB in Dorset. I also Birdwatch the Cambridgeshire, Norfolk, and Suffolk areas. I also have day trips out to other Birding Sites. All of these experiences are shared on my website Steve Carey Bird Photography through photographs and articles.

feeds.title: Rosyfinch Ramblings
feeds.description: Rosyfinch Ramblings is a blog dedicated entirely to finding birds and beauty close to home. Amazing photographs of birds captured by Kenneth Cole Schneider are shared in this blog.

feeds.title: Birds of Saudi Arabia
feeds.description: My name is Jem Babbington and I am a keen birder and amateur photographer. Browse my latest images from the field. Most of the photographs are of birds but also I include various other interesting wildlife photography and natural history shots I take are published on this website. The kingdom of Saudi Arabia is very much under-watched by the birders. So this website is an attempt to share wonderful clicks of the birds of Saudi Arabia to rectify this situation in a small way.

feeds.title: Mirrorless Comparison » Bird
feeds.description: Hi! We're Heather and Mat from MirrorLessons and this section of our blog features articles that have to do solely with Bird Photography. Read informative articles about various mirrorless cameras used for capturing moments of birds in flight, and also a comparison of different cameras which are majorly been used for bird photography. We also share instructive articles like the best settings of the camera to use, buying guides, and many more.

feeds.title: Fly Wright Photography Blog
feeds.description: My name is Eric Wright, and I am an award-winning photographer with a background in communications, design, and teaching. On this website, Fly Wright Photography, wonderful photographs of Family, Senior, and headshot portraits, along with nature, birds, and landscape, each year are posted along with the articles regarding that particular photo.

feeds.title: Colyton Wildlife
feeds.description: I'm Tim White and I'm a blogger since 2010. My blogs are Colyton Wildlife and Artistic Photography. Colyton Wildlife is a blog about wildlife and photography, mostly in and around the Axe valley and Artistic Photography is a blog that includes various informative articles completely based on photography content.

feeds.title: Elizabeth River Bird Blog » Bird Photography
feeds.description: This segment of our blog features articles that have to do exclusively with the Bird photography. I'm Dave Gibson, my blog includes Personal notes and thoughts on birds and bird photography, documentaries, wildlife photography, Portrait photography, and many more.

feeds.title: Feathered Photography Blog
feeds.description: I'm Ron Dudley, the three primary goals of Feathered Photography is to showcase a few of my images, to document interesting bird behaviors, and to illustrate and discuss different aspects of bird and nature photography. Avian Photography and analysis of bird behavior is the major aspect that is been covered on the Feather photography website.

feeds.title: Nature Photography Simplified
feeds.description: My name is Prathap. I am a professional photographer and the founder of this blog. This blog is based on my philosophy of 'Simplicity.' I am always in pursuit of some unique photographs of nature which include ultimate bird photography and wildlife photography. I believe strongly in simplicity whether it is about life, photography, or any other thing. This blog is dedicated to sharing my photography knowledge in the most simple yet practical manner.
